_comment: Phase 11 tutor intent routing. ROUTING ONLY: keyword/regex matchers that map free-text questions onto (a) recorded Phase 8 refusal topics, (b) recorded Phase 8 system ids, (c) the Phase 7 parcel-deferral state, (d) anatomical-vocabulary used only to distinguish NOT_REPRESENTED from UNKNOWN. References Phase 6/8 records by id only. Duplicates NO claim text, NO citations, NO evidence, NO mechanisms, NO criteria — all answer content is read live from the recorded layers at query time.

refusal_routes.note: Backstop: Phase 8 clinical-intent patterns already route receptor/transmitter phrasing to the guard. Residual receptor-localization phrasing maps to the recorded NOT_REPRESENTED template.
Backstop: drug/mechanism phrasing is normally caught by the clinical-intent guard first. Maps to the recorded NOT_REPRESENTED template.
Causal phrasing about conditions maps to the recorded INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE template. Correlation is not causation.

Backstop: diagnostic phrasing is normally caught by the clinical-intent guard first. Maps to the recorded INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE template.
Backstop: treatment/dose/prognosis phrasing is normally caught by the clinical-intent guard first. Maps to the recorded INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE template.
